ACTSC 221: Introductory Financial Mathematics (Non-Specialist Level)
Description: The theory of rates of interest and discount; annuities and sinking funds with practical applications to mortgage and bond questions. Yield rates.
Requirements: Prereq: Level at least 2A; Not open to Actuarial Science students. Antireq: ACTSC 231; (For Mathematics students only - CIVE 292/392)
